parameters.content:
## A · Loan product discovery
Runs daily at 06:00 IST. Crawls each active row of `crawl_sources` one at a time.

- The page text is fingerprinted with SHA-256. **Unchanged pages skip the LLM entirely.**
- Changed pages go to OpenAI with a strict JSON schema, then every value is range-checked.
- Products are upserted; a criteria change bumps `version`, which invalidates cached LLM verdicts.
- Products that vanish from a page are retired, never deleted. An empty extraction keeps the last known products.

parameters.query:
select s.source_id,
       s.lender,
       s.url,
       (select r.content_hash
          from crawl_runs r
         where r.source_id = s.source_id
           and r.status in ('updated', 'unchanged')
         order by r.created_at desc
         limit 1) as last_hash
from crawl_sources s
where s.is_active
order by s.source_id

parameters.jsCode:
const prompt = "You extract personal loan products from the text of an Indian bank or loan-aggregator web page.
Return every distinct personal loan product the page describes.

- lender: the bank or NBFC offering the product. On aggregator pages each lender is its own product.
- product_name: the product name. If the page names none, use "<lender> Personal Loan".
  When the page gives different criteria for salaried and self-employed applicants, return one product per segment,
  e.g. "<lender> Personal Loan (Salaried)" and "<lender> Personal Loan (Self-employed)". Never merge their criteria.
- interest_rate_min / interest_rate_max: annual interest rate in percent, e.g. 10.85.
- min_monthly_income: minimum net monthly income in rupees. Divide annual figures by 12. 1 lakh = 100000.
  If the threshold varies by city, employer or employment type, use the lowest and explain the rest in qualitative_criteria.
- min_credit_score / max_credit_score: CIBIL score bounds.
- min_age / max_age: applicant age limits in years.
- employment_types: which of salaried, self_employed, business the product accepts.
  Self-employed professionals (doctors, CAs, architects) are self_employed.
  Self-employed non-professionals, traders and business owners are business.
  Return an empty list when the page does not say.
- qualitative_criteria: one or two sentences with applicant-profile rules the numeric fields cannot express,
  such as work experience, employer category, city of residence, age at loan maturity, business vintage or ITR history.
  Null when there are none. Never list documents.
- max_amount: largest loan amount in rupees. max_tenure_months: longest tenure in months.
- processing_fee: short text as stated on the page.
- confidence: 0 to 1, how explicitly the page states the eligibility criteria.

Use null for anything the page does not state. Never invent values.";
const schema = {"type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "required": ["products"], "properties": {"products": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "required": ["lender", "product_name", "interest_rate_min", "interest_rate_max", "min_monthly_income", "min_credit_score", "max_credit_score", "min_age", "max_age", "employment_types", "qualitative_criteria", "max_amount", "max_tenure_months", "processing_fee", "confidence"], "properties": {"lender": {"type": "string"}, "product_name": {"type": "string"}, "interest_rate_min": {"type": ["number", "null"]}, "interest_rate_max": {"type": ["number", "null"]}, "min_monthly_income": {"type": ["integer", "null"]}, "min_credit_score": {"type": ["integer", "null"]}, "max_credit_score": {"type": ["integer", "null"]}, "min_age": {"type": ["integer", "null"]}, "max_age": {"type": ["integer", "null"]}, "employment_types": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string", "enum": ["salaried", "self_employed", "business"]}}, "qualitative_criteria": {"type": ["string", "null"]}, "max_amount": {"type": ["integer", "null"]}, "max_tenure_months": {"type": ["integer", "null"]}, "processing_fee": {"type": ["string", "null"]}, "confidence": {"type": "number"}}}}}};

return {
  json: {
    ...$json,
    request: {
      model: $env.OPENAI_MODEL,
      temperature: 0,
      response_format: { type: 'json_schema', json_schema: { name: 'loan_products', strict: true, schema } },
      messages: [
        { role: 'system', content: prompt },
        { role: 'user', content: `Source: ${$json.lender} (${$json.url})

${$json.text}` },
      ],
    },
  },
};

parameters.query:
with incoming as (
    select *
    from jsonb_to_recordset($4::jsonb) as p (
        lender text,
        product_name text,
        interest_rate_min numeric,
        interest_rate_max numeric,
        min_monthly_income integer,
        min_credit_score smallint,
        max_credit_score smallint,
        min_age smallint,
        max_age smallint,
        employment_types text[],
        qualitative_criteria text,
        max_amount bigint,
        max_tenure_months smallint,
        processing_fee text,
        extraction_confidence numeric,
        criteria_hash text
    )
),
upserted as (
    insert into loan_products (
        source_id, source_url, lender, product_name, interest_rate_min, interest_rate_max,
        min_monthly_income, min_credit_score, max_credit_score, min_age, max_age, employment_types,
        qualitative_criteria, max_amount, max_tenure_months, processing_fee, extraction_confidence, criteria_hash
    )
    select $1::int, $2, lender, product_name, interest_rate_min, interest_rate_max,
           min_monthly_income, min_credit_score, max_credit_score, min_age, max_age, employment_types,
           qualitative_criteria, max_amount, max_tenure_months, processing_fee, extraction_confidence, criteria_hash
    from incoming
    on conflict (source_id, lender, product_name) do update set
        source_url = excluded.source_url,
        interest_rate_min = excluded.interest_rate_min,
        interest_rate_max = excluded.interest_rate_max,
        min_monthly_income = excluded.min_monthly_income,
        min_credit_score = excluded.min_credit_score,
        max_credit_score = excluded.max_credit_score,
        min_age = excluded.min_age,
        max_age = excluded.max_age,
        employment_types = excluded.employment_types,
        qualitative_criteria = excluded.qualitative_criteria,
        max_amount = excluded.max_amount,
        max_tenure_months = excluded.max_tenure_months,
        processing_fee = excluded.processing_fee,
        extraction_confidence = excluded.extraction_confidence,
        criteria_hash = excluded.criteria_hash,
        version = loan_products.version
                  + case when loan_products.criteria_hash = excluded.criteria_hash then 0 else 1 end,
        is_active = true,
        last_seen_at = now()
    returning product_id
),
retired as (
    update loan_products
    set is_active = false
    where source_id = $1::int
      and is_active
      and exists (select 1 from incoming)
      and (lender, product_name) not in (select lender, product_name from incoming)
    returning product_id
)
insert into crawl_runs (source_id, http_status, content_hash, changed, products_found, status)
select $1::int,
       200,
       $3,
       true,
       (select count(*) from upserted),
       case when exists (select 1 from incoming) then 'updated' else 'empty' end
returning source_id, status, products_found, (select count(*) from retired) as products_retired

insert into crawl_runs (source_id, http_status, content_hash, changed, status, error)
values ($1::int, $2::int, $3, false, $4, $5)
returning source_id, status

values ($1::int, $2::int, $3, false, $4, $5)
returning source_id, status
